comment: Written BEFORE any court code (the W discipline). The Principal ruled HARO-MENU-CITES-01 on 2026-11-02 (LEDGER.md line 156): an envelope cites only what exists; a MENU may carry CITES as a CONSTRAINT does; where the contract binds nothing the cite is none, never rule:<CODE> for a rule that does not exist. v0.28 answers it for every element that carries a CODE: MENU, RANGE, FORMAT and UNION take CITES as CONSTRAINT (v0.23), REFUSAL and SYMBOL (v0.11) do. Three spellings, each meaning one thing: a list of cites replaces the default; the word none says the refusal cites nothing (the envelope's cites is [], which the Diagnostic Contract calls honest where no law applies, 2.5); no CITES clause keeps the default every court has cited since v0.11, so no court prints a different byte. An empty list is refused by name -- the machine language's own idiom for EGRESS ("a list names where the machine may go, and the word none says it goes nowhere"). R2 reverses an acceptance: from v0.23 to v0.27 an empty CITES on a CONSTRAINT was read as the default, silently; no estate file wrote one.

accepts.name: every element that carries a CODE may carry CITES: a MENU, a RANGE, a FORMAT and a UNION, each citing what its contract binds
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE notice AS (VERSION "0.28", GRAMMAR "0.28", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".notice") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU tones AS (WORDS [plain, formal], CODE "INVALID_TONE", CITES ["rule:4"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE RANGE lengths AS (MIN 1, MAX 300, CODE "TOO_LONG", CITES ["right:read-in-one-sitting"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT archive_path AS (SHAPE absolute_path, CODE "BAD_ARCHIVE", CITES ["pattern:absolute-path"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION office AS (VERB "OFFICE", SEATS [head: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION desk AS (VERB "DESK", SEATS [clerk: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION issuers AS (OF [office, desk], CODE "NO_ISSUER", CITES ["rule:2", "article:1"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION notice AS (VERB "NOTICE", SEATS [issuer: issuers, tone: tones, length: lengths, archive: archive_path]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: the word none on every element that cites -- MENU, RANGE, FORMAT, UNION, CONSTRAINT, REFUSAL, SYMBOL: where the contract binds nothing, the refusal cites nothing
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE notice AS (VERSION "0.28", GRAMMAR "0.28", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".notice") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU tones AS (WORDS [plain, formal], CODE "INVALID_TONE", CITES none) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE RANGE lengths AS (MIN 1, MAX 300, CODE "TOO_LONG", CITES none) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT archive_path AS (SHAPE absolute_path, CODE "BAD_ARCHIVE", CITES none) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION office AS (VERB "OFFICE", SEATS [head: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION desk AS (VERB "DESK", SEATS [clerk: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION issuers AS (OF [office, desk], CODE "NO_ISSUER", CITES none) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION notice AS (VERB "NOTICE", SEATS [issuer: issuers, tone: tones, length: lengths, archive: archive_path]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SYMBOL flow AS (KIND "flow", REF "calls", CODE "UNRESOLVED_FLOW", CITES none) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT short_formal AS (ON notice, WHEN "tone = formal and length < 3", MESSAGE "x", CODE "SHORT_FORMAL", CITES none) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_verb AS (MESSAGE "the verb set is closed", CODE "UNKNOWN_VERB", CITES none) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: CITES without a CODE: the element keeps its default code and cites what it declares
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE notice AS (VERSION "0.28", GRAMMAR "0.28", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".notice") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU tones AS (WORDS [plain, formal], CITES ["rule:4"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION notice AS (VERB "NOTICE", SEATS [tone: tones]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: an element without CITES is read as before (v0.11): nothing a v0.27 language declared changes
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE notice AS (VERSION "0.28", GRAMMAR "0.28", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".notice") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU tones AS (WORDS [plain, formal], MESSAGE "TONE is plain or formal, not {value}", CODE "INVALID_TONE") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE RANGE lengths AS (MIN 1, MAX 300) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION notice AS (VERB "NOTICE", SEATS [tone: tones, length: lengths]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: an empty CITES on a MENU says nothing: the word none says it cites nothing
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE notice AS (VERSION "0.28", GRAMMAR "0.28", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".notice") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU tones AS (WORDS [plain, formal], CODE "INVALID_TONE", CITES []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION notice AS (VERB "NOTICE", SEATS [tone: tones]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: an empty CITES says nothing: a list names what the refusal cites, and the word none says it cites nothing

rejects.name: an empty CITES on a CONSTRAINT, read as the default from v0.23 to v0.27, is refused by name now (HF-55: a reversal, never silent)
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE notice AS (VERSION "0.28", GRAMMAR "0.28", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".notice") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU tones AS (WORDS [plain, formal]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION notice AS (VERB "NOTICE", SEATS [tone: tones, length: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT short_formal AS (ON notice, WHEN "tone = formal and length < 3", MESSAGE "x", CODE "SHORT_FORMAL", CITES []) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: an empty CITES says nothing: a list names what the refusal cites, and the word none says it cites nothing

rejects.name: an empty CITES on a REFUSAL says nothing either: a refusal that cites nothing says none
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE notice AS (VERSION "0.28", GRAMMAR "0.28", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".notice") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION notice AS (VERB "NOTICE", SEATS [head: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_verb AS (MESSAGE "the verb set is closed", CODE "UNKNOWN_VERB", CITES []) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: an empty CITES says nothing: a list names what the refusal cites, and the word none says it cites nothing

rejects.name: CITES takes a list of cites or the word none, and no other word
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE notice AS (VERSION "0.28", GRAMMAR "0.28", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".notice") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE RANGE lengths AS (MIN 1, MAX 300, CODE "TOO_LONG", CITES nothing) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION notice AS (VERB "NOTICE", SEATS [length: lengths]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: CITES is a list of cites or the word none, not 'nothing'

rejects.name: a FORMAT's cite is kind:value, as every cite since v0.11
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE notice AS (VERSION "0.28", GRAMMAR "0.28", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".notice") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT archive_path AS (SHAPE absolute_path, CODE "BAD_ARCHIVE", CITES ["absolute-path"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION notice AS (VERB "NOTICE", SEATS [archive: archive_path]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: 'absolute-path' on archive_path is not a cite: kind:value with kind rule, article, right or pattern

rejects.name: a UNION's cite names one of the four binding kinds: law is not one
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE notice AS (VERSION "0.28", GRAMMAR "0.28", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".notice") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION office AS (VERB "OFFICE", SEATS [head: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION desk AS (VERB "DESK", SEATS [clerk: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION issuers AS (OF [office, desk], CODE "NO_ISSUER", CITES ["law:2"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION notice AS (VERB "NOTICE", SEATS [issuer: issuers]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: 'law:2' on issuers is not a cite

rejects.name: a DECLARATION carries no CITES: its seats are coded by CODES, and v0.28 does not grow a cite per seat
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE notice AS (VERSION "0.28", GRAMMAR "0.28", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".notice") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION notice AS (VERB "NOTICE", SEATS [head: text], CITES ["rule:1"]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: CITES given twice on a MENU, a list and the word none, is refused as any clause given twice
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE notice AS (VERSION "0.28", GRAMMAR "0.28", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".notice") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU tones AS (WORDS [plain, formal], CITES ["rule:4"], CITES none) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION notice AS (VERB "NOTICE", SEATS [tone: tones]) RATIONALE "x"
